answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 500 fakes pays 333 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. Cloud rentals charge by the minute, and the farm rents a thousand minutes. The cedar test is the live device, the vault test is the locked stake, and the forge test is the graded history no template can fake. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
